# OA v0.7.30

**Status:** Public development preview

**Release date:** 2026-08-31

**Source:** [`v0.7.30`](https://github.com/realminc/oa/releases/tag/v0.7.30)

## Summary

OA v0.7.30 adds the CPU spatial-animation foundation used by rendering,
rigging, retargeting, and simulation, then rebuilds the shared image, audio,
and video Viewer around one polished Vulkan presentation path. It remains a
pre-1.0 development preview rather than a stable source or binary contract.

## Highlights

- Public transform, camera, joint, pose, clip, keyframe, curve, and animation
  operations share the fixed Vulkan-native VLM convention.
- Image, audio, and all four codec-profile video tutorials consume one Viewer
  implementation with the same layout, navigation, media controls, menus, and
  tooltips.
- Viewer navigation and retained widgets share selectable Normal, Fast,
  Fastest, and Instant motion presets.
- Non-looping audio/video restart from the beginning after end-of-stream, and
  video cache seeks no longer preserve stale completion state.

## Added

- `oa::Transform`/`oa::FnTransform` and `oa::Joint`/`oa::FnJoint` public pairs.
- Immutable `oa::SkelPose`, uniform `oa::AnimClip`, sparse typed
  `oa::Keyframe`/`oa::AnimCurve`, and stateless `oa::FnAnim` operations.
- A shared `oa::UiMotionSpeed` contract for Viewer navigation and retained
  widget transitions.
- GPU vector primitives for filled transport glyphs, rounded viewport masks,
  anchored popup arrows, and the adaptive image-space canvas grid.

## Improved

- The Viewer uses a borderless dark presentation surface with dithered
  gradient, image-space grid, exact pan/zoom/fit, synchronized audio waveform
  and media timelines, and one chrome layout across image, audio, and video.
- Menus, dropdowns, and tooltips measure their contents, clamp to the render
  viewport, flip above their anchor when necessary, and use rounded rows,
  shadows, pointer arrows, and a 15-logical-pixel Adwaita silhouette.
- Audio waveform, spectrum, and mel views share the media timeline geometry;
  timeline and waveform drags now update one another continuously.
- Playing audio and video hide inactive chrome, including immediately when the
  pointer leaves the native window.

## Fixed

- Pressing Play or Space after non-looping end-of-stream seeks to the beginning
  before resuming instead of leaving the player logically complete.
- Cache-resident video seeks clear stale EOS state and non-looping playback
  stops the video and attached audio clocks together.
- Obsolete detection and CV tutorial targets that no longer matched maintained
  contracts were removed instead of preserved as misleading examples.

## Compatibility and migration

This preview consolidates the former `CameraState` and SDK-local transform and
joint surfaces. Rebuild native and Python consumers; pre-1.0 binary
compatibility is not claimed.

- Use `oa::Camera` with `oa::FnCamera` for camera state and operations.
- Use `oa::Transform` with `oa::FnTransform` for shared spatial state.
- Use the `oa::Joint`, `oa::SkelPose`, `oa::AnimClip`, `oa::Keyframe`,
  `oa::AnimCurve`, and `oa::FnAnim` animation surface.
- Discard pre-1.0 serialized scene, animation, pipeline, and execution-plan
  caches before rebuilding.

## Verification

| Gate | Result | Evidence scope |
|---|---|---|
| Release UI | Pass | 61/61 UI contract and real-Vulkan composition tests |
| ASAN/LSAN | Pass | 61/61 UI cases; leak detection, strict strings, halt-on-error |
| UBSAN | Pass | 61/61 UI cases; halt-on-error |
| Video replay | Pass | H.264 hardware-YCbCr cached-EOS recovery on the committed fixture |
| Physical GPU | Pass, scoped | Intel Iris Xe TGL, Mesa 26.1.7, Vulkan 1.4.354 |
| Complete hosted release | Pending | Tagged build, sanitizer, package, wheel, assets, checksums, and PyPI workflow |

The public tagged workflow owns the complete hosted result. Dataset-gated
multi-codec tests are not represented as passing when their external fixtures
are absent.

## Known limitations

- The polished Viewer path is currently qualified on one Linux GNOME/Wayland
  and Intel Vulkan configuration; other desktops, DPI configurations, and GPU
  drivers remain unverified.
- Popups and tooltips stay inside the single Viewer render surface. Rendering
  beyond the native window would require a separate transient window and
  presentation surface.
- VLM and the animation foundation are CPU-only. GPU-resident bulk spatial work
  requires a measured operation-graph consumer.
- Vulkan Video codec, profile, encode/decode, and hardware-YCbCr availability
  remain capability- and driver-gated.

## Upgrade

Update to `v0.7.30`, rebuild native and Python consumers, regenerate generated
bindings, and discard pre-1.0 scene, animation, pipeline, and execution-plan
caches. Applications using the old camera or SDK-local transform/joint types
must migrate to the public OA pairs above.
